speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit. The loaf is going on the board, and I am not changing the price to comfort you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: What have you against the loaf?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It wants a full thumb of my husband's notch. The price is a penny. A thumb.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: She measured it twice. The loaf doesn't get a vote.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A thumb, and a penny. I have a friar for you, since you will have the morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In Verona. An old friar at dawn, with a basket. He has a line I was given on the road. Wisely and slow. They stumble that run fast.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A friar I can approve. Herbs, and a warning. That is a Christian man.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He marries them the same afternoon.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Without their fathers' leave? Then he is no better than the Nurse. Mark me, it will end in a churchyard.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is the girl the one at the window? The rose?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The same house. Not the same hour. This is the friar's hour. Hers was the garden, and that is already written.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Already written is not already excused. Fathers' leave is the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Gib is asleep on Brooke, on the table. The chronicle is still in the room, under its cloth. I am not sending it back.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: He walked off the cloth himself, onto the lovers. I didn't take the cloth off.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Master Field's book is not a bed, and neither is the other. You may say a cat keeps it. You may not say I approved the cat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have your churchyard. I heard it. I'll eat.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then don't ask me to bless a man who marries children behind their fathers. I blessed him until you said the afternoon.
